stages.title: Python language fluency
stages.objective: Write an idiomatic, memory-bounded ledger CLI.
stages.scenario: Malformed exports, duplicates and mixed encodings arrive in a finance batch.
stages.progression: Row parser → packaged CLI → repeatable reconciliation.
stages.gate: Independently process malformed input from a clean checkout.

topics.title: Syntax and control flow
topics.concepts: Indentation, truthiness, None, branches, loops and f-strings.
topics.exercise: Write a typed row validator.
topics.assessment: When can truthiness discard valid values?
topics.pass: Test zero, empty text, missing field and whitespace independently.

topics.title: Object identity and money
topics.concepts: Names bind objects; aliasing, shallow copy, identity vs equality and Decimal.
topics.exercise: Repair state leaking between two ledger imports.
topics.assessment: Why can a mutable default affect later calls?
topics.pass: Independent runs produce exact deterministic totals.

topics.title: Lists, tuples and deque
topics.concepts: Slicing, comprehensions, ordering, append and front-removal costs.
topics.exercise: Write a bounded recent-record buffer.
topics.assessment: When does a deque improve on a list?
topics.pass: Demonstrate ordered output and bounded size.

topics.title: Dictionaries and sets
topics.concepts: Hashability, composite keys, counting and set membership.
topics.exercise: Deduplicate ledger records by source and ID.
topics.assessment: Which tuples cannot be dict keys?
topics.pass: Preserve deterministic counts and justify average lookup costs.

topics.title: Functions and scope
topics.concepts: Positional and keyword args, closures, return values and LEGB scope.
topics.exercise: Extract pure transformations from I/O.
topics.assessment: When is a closure a useful dependency boundary?
topics.pass: Run parametrized transformations without files.

topics.title: Modules and imports
topics.concepts: Module/package resolution, entry points and import side effects.
topics.exercise: Separate CLI, read/parse and business modules.
topics.assessment: How do you remove a cyclic import?
topics.pass: Imports perform no I/O and work from a clean install.

topics.title: File I/O and streaming
topics.concepts: pathlib, CSV, JSONL, encoding, buffering and atomic replacement.
topics.exercise: Stream and reconcile a large ledger export.
topics.assessment: Why is encoding part of the interface?
topics.pass: Corrupt input preserves the previous output.

topics.title: Errors and cleanup
topics.concepts: Typed exceptions, chaining, finally, exit codes and terminal errors.
topics.exercise: Inject disk and format failures in a CLI.
topics.assessment: Which layer turns an exception into an exit code?
topics.pass: Report actionable causes without exposing sensitive rows.

topics.title: Environments and packaging
topics.concepts: Virtual environments, uv locking, pyproject, wheels and entry points.
topics.exercise: Install the wheel in a separate environment.
topics.assessment: What can editable installation hide?
topics.pass: Installed command works from outside the repository.

topics.title: Ruff and type checking
topics.concepts: Lint, format, Pyright or mypy; generics, unions, narrowing and Any.
topics.exercise: Set up CI and type a parsed payload.
topics.assessment: Which errors does static analysis miss?
topics.pass: CI rejects wrong imports, nullable calls and payload types.

stages.title: Advanced Python engineering
stages.objective: Build typed, testable, packaged services with explicit resource ownership.
stages.scenario: A large import mixes blocking downloads and CPU parsing.
stages.progression: Typed adapters → concurrent importer → benchmarked worker.
stages.gate: Cancellation releases resources; type checking, lint and tests pass.

topics.title: Objects and classes
topics.concepts: Identity, instance behavior and self.
topics.exercise: Model an import job.
topics.assessment: When is a pure function simpler?
topics.pass: Separate instances maintain independent state.

topics.title: Constructors and attributes
topics.concepts: __init__, invariants and instance attributes.
topics.exercise: Reject invalid jobs at initialization.
topics.assessment: Which data belongs in a constructor?
topics.pass: Tests cover missing and invalid fields.

topics.title: Class attributes
topics.concepts: Attribute sharing, lookup and shadowing.
topics.exercise: Fix a shared-list error.
topics.assessment: Where is the attribute resolved?
topics.pass: Instances no longer share unintended mutations.

topics.title: Instance methods
topics.concepts: Bound methods, self and behavior on instance state.
topics.exercise: Implement an import job transition.
topics.assessment: Why bind the behavior to the object?
topics.pass: Reject invalid transitions and preserve invariants.

topics.title: Class methods
topics.concepts: cls and alternate constructors.
topics.exercise: Add from_row to a typed model.
topics.assessment: Why return cls(...) rather than a fixed class?
topics.pass: Subtype construction and validation work.

topics.title: Static methods
topics.concepts: Class namespace and unbound helpers.
topics.exercise: Compare static method and module function.
topics.assessment: Who owns this operation?
topics.pass: Show identical behavior and justify the API location.

topics.title: Encapsulation
topics.concepts: Public contract, underscore convention and mutation control.
topics.exercise: Expose a read-only status view.
topics.assessment: What does a leading underscore guarantee?
topics.pass: All public mutations preserve invariants.

topics.title: Inheritance
topics.concepts: Subtype contracts and inherited behavior.
topics.exercise: Implement a parser subtype.
topics.assessment: When does a subtype couple you to implementation?
topics.pass: Run shared contract tests.

topics.title: Overriding
topics.concepts: Dispatch, super and compatible behavior.
topics.exercise: Override a parser hook.
topics.assessment: What breaks when an override narrows input?
topics.pass: Base guarantees still hold.

topics.title: Polymorphism
topics.concepts: Duck typing and substitutable adapters.
topics.exercise: Swap native and OCR adapters.
topics.assessment: Which errors belong in the contract?
topics.pass: Run one suite against both.

topics.title: Abstraction and ABCs
topics.concepts: Minimal consumer API, ABC and abstractmethod.
topics.exercise: Block incomplete DocumentReader implementations.
topics.assessment: When is a structural protocol preferable?
topics.pass: Incomplete implementation cannot be instantiated.

topics.title: Composition
topics.concepts: Delegation and replaceable dependencies.
topics.exercise: Compose parser, validator and sink.
topics.assessment: Why compose this pipeline?
topics.pass: Swap the sink without subclassing.

topics.title: Multiple inheritance and MRO
topics.concepts: Mixins, diamond lookup and cooperative super.
topics.exercise: Predict and check a tiny class hierarchy.
topics.assessment: Why can base order change behavior?
topics.pass: Prediction matches __mro__ and output.

topics.title: Properties and descriptors
topics.concepts: property, getter/setter and descriptor protocol intuition.
topics.exercise: Add a validated transition attribute.
topics.assessment: Why can a property appear to be a field?
topics.pass: Invalid changes fail with useful errors.

topics.title: Dataclasses
topics.concepts: Generated methods, default_factory, frozen and equality.
topics.exercise: Model an immutable document key.
topics.assessment: Does frozen deep-freeze nested data?
topics.pass: Check equality and independent defaults.

topics.title: Protocols and generics
topics.concepts: Structural typing, Protocol, TypeVar and runtime limits.
topics.exercise: Check fake and real clients against one consumer interface.
topics.assessment: Where does runtime validation belong?
topics.pass: Checker rejects an incompatible implementation.

topics.title: SOLID, DI and patterns
topics.concepts: Interface segregation, explicit lifetimes, adapter, strategy and composition root.
topics.exercise: Inject a fake clock and swap two adapters.
topics.assessment: What change justifies an interface here?
topics.pass: Tests expose no external resource dependencies and one rejected pattern is documented.

topics.title: Iterators and generators
topics.concepts: Iterable vs iterator, yield, exhaustion and cleanup.
topics.exercise: Stream fixed-size batches.
topics.assessment: Which iterables can be replayed?
topics.pass: Memory grows with batch size rather than input length.

topics.title: Decorators and context managers
topics.concepts: Closures, wraps, with, async with and cleanup on error.
topics.exercise: Instrument calls and manage client lifetimes.
topics.assessment: When may __exit__ suppress an exception?
topics.pass: Failures and cancellation release resources.

topics.title: pytest fixtures and test levels
topics.concepts: Fixtures, parametrization, fake dependencies and database integration.
topics.exercise: Add unit and integration tests.
topics.assessment: What does an HTTP stub hide?
topics.pass: Tests isolate state and catch a seeded regression.

topics.title: Event loop and structured concurrency
topics.concepts: Awaitables, TaskGroup, deadlines, cancellation, queues and semaphores.
topics.exercise: Bound concurrent downloads and cancel a parent.
topics.assessment: Why does blocking I/O stall unrelated requests?
topics.pass: Assert peak concurrency and no orphan tasks.

topics.title: Threads and processes
topics.concepts: GIL considerations, shared memory, locks, serialization, process startup and pools.
topics.exercise: Compare threads for I/O and processes for parsing.
topics.assessment: What makes a process pool slower on small input?
topics.pass: Measure throughput and repair a shared-state bug.

topics.title: Memory and profiling
topics.concepts: References, cycles, RSS, cProfile and tracemalloc.
topics.exercise: Diagnose and remove retained batches.
topics.assessment: Why might RSS stay elevated?
topics.pass: Publish before/after timings and accuracy.

topics.title: Python application architecture
topics.concepts: Domain modules, adapters, configuration and transaction ownership.
topics.exercise: Separate API and worker entry points around a shared service.
topics.assessment: Where should a transaction start and end?
topics.pass: Domain tests run independently from HTTP and the database.

stages.title: Applied math and machine learning
stages.objective: Interpret formulas and evaluate practical models with honest baselines.
stages.scenario: High accuracy hides missed urgent tickets.
stages.gate: Defend held-out split, threshold and results by slice.

topics.title: Scalars, vectors and matrices
topics.concepts: Concept, hand calculation, NumPy and interpretation; shapes, transpose and broadcasting.
topics.exercise: Predict then implement matrix products, vector operations and projections.
topics.assessment: What does each output axis mean?
topics.pass: Hand results and NumPy agree; detect an unintended broadcast.

topics.title: Dot product and cosine
topics.concepts: Hand calculation, derivation intuition, NumPy; norms and normalization.
topics.exercise: Implement cosine with a defined zero-vector policy.
topics.assessment: When do dot and cosine rankings agree?
topics.pass: Matches reference calculations with safe zero handling.

topics.title: Eigenvectors and SVD
topics.concepts: Concept and interpretation; principal directions and compression.
topics.exercise: Inspect PCA explained variance.
topics.assessment: When could dimensionality reduction hurt retrieval?
topics.pass: Explain a direction and trade-off.

topics.title: Probability and Bayes
topics.concepts: Concept, hand, NumPy and interpretation; expectation, variance, base rates and conditional probability.
topics.exercise: Simulate rare alerts then hand-check posterior.
topics.assessment: Why can most positive predictions be false?
topics.pass: Estimates align within sampling error.

topics.title: Statistics and uncertainty
topics.concepts: Concept and interpretation; sampling bias, percentiles, intervals and paired bootstrap.
topics.exercise: Implement bootstrap for a paired quality delta.
topics.assessment: When should you resample by document or tenant?
topics.pass: Report an interval and effective sampling unit.

topics.title: Derivatives, gradients and losses
topics.concepts: Hand and NumPy; derive scalar MSE derivative, chain rule, cross-entropy intuition, SGD and learning rate.
topics.exercise: Train a tiny regressor and check finite differences.
topics.assessment: Why can a large learning rate diverge?
topics.pass: Analytic and numerical gradients agree and plot shows convergence.

topics.title: Regression
topics.concepts: Linear baseline, MAE/RMSE and residuals.
topics.exercise: Predict resolution time from allowed features.
topics.assessment: When is MAE preferable?
topics.pass: Report median baseline and errors by severity.

topics.title: Classification
topics.concepts: Logistic and tree baselines, precision/recall/F1, PR-AUC and calibration.
topics.exercise: Set urgent-ticket threshold on validation data.
topics.assessment: How can discrimination and calibration disagree?
topics.pass: Report held-out false negatives and threshold cost.

topics.title: Clustering
topics.concepts: K-means, scaling, centroids and stability.
topics.exercise: Explore recurring topics in embedding data.
topics.assessment: Why isn't a cluster automatically a label?
topics.pass: Assess stability and review a sample for coherence.

topics.title: Features, validation and leakage
topics.concepts: Categorical/text features, missing data, pipelines, grouped/temporal splits, underfit and overfit.
topics.exercise: Compare naive and safe validation and show learning curves.
topics.assessment: Can a ticket ID leak timing?
topics.pass: Preprocessing runs within folds and holdout stays locked.

stages.title: Document data engineering
stages.objective: Create durable provenance from source to derived artifacts.
stages.scenario: Corrected scans replace older versions while work is in flight.
stages.progression: Canonicalizer → document API → replay and delete.
stages.gate: Replay preserves identity and deletion removes derived data.

topics.title: Data contracts and provenance
topics.concepts: Schemas, encoding, hashes, raw versions, object storage and quarantine.
topics.exercise: Write immutable source manifests.
topics.assessment: Why separate business identity from content hash?
topics.pass: Rebuild a derived artifact from the original bytes.

topics.title: Parsing and cleaning
topics.concepts: Native text, PDF reading order, tables, Unicode and source offsets.
topics.exercise: Build adapters and golden fixtures.
topics.assessment: What evidence can aggressive cleanup destroy?
topics.pass: Preserve page references and a representative table.

topics.title: OCR and document lifecycle
topics.concepts: Page rasterization, confidence, language packs, idempotent versions and tombstones.
topics.exercise: Add OCR fallback and replay replace/delete concurrently.
topics.assessment: How can replay resurrect a deleted source?
topics.pass: Demonstrate final-state consistency and measure OCR quality.

topics.title: Columnar storage and batch processing
topics.concepts: Row vs column formats, Parquet, filtering and chunked reads.
topics.exercise: Benchmark one evaluation export.
topics.assessment: When is CSV adequate?
topics.pass: Report representative size and scan time.

stages.title: Python backend engineering
stages.prerequisite: Typed Python and working SQL knowledge
stages.objective: Build APIs that are correct across auth, transactions and disconnects.
stages.scenario: A streaming client disconnects while the database pool is saturated.
stages.progression: Ticket CRUD → durable processing → streaming service.
stages.gate: Deploy the API, show rollback and tenant-denial tests, then explain a slow trace.

topics.title: FastAPI routing and OpenAPI
topics.concepts: ASGI, routes, status codes, pagination and response contracts.
topics.exercise: Build versioned ticket routes and diff OpenAPI.
topics.assessment: When do you return 202?
topics.pass: Contract tests detect breaking schema changes.

topics.title: Pydantic request/response models
topics.concepts: Coercion, strict fields, errors and serialization boundaries.
topics.exercise: Separate request, domain and response models.
topics.assessment: When is coercion dangerous?
topics.pass: Invalid input fails and internal fields never serialize.

topics.title: FastAPI dependency injection and exceptions
topics.concepts: Depends, request scope, yield, overrides and domain error translation.
topics.exercise: Inject identity and a session, map conflict and timeout.
topics.assessment: Who owns transaction rollback?
topics.pass: Resources close on errors and logs omit secrets.

topics.title: Authentication and authorization
topics.concepts: OIDC, issuer, audience, expiry, tenant and resource-level permission.
topics.exercise: Authorize ticket access with an IdP and test revoked roles.
topics.assessment: Where does a JWT stop proving access?
topics.pass: Wrong-tenant and expired-token tests deny correctly.

topics.title: SQLAlchemy and PostgreSQL plans
topics.concepts: Sessions, Alembic, pool, isolation, constraints, locks, indexes and EXPLAIN ANALYZE.
topics.exercise: Tune queue polling under concurrent writes.
topics.assessment: Why shouldn't two async tasks share a session?
topics.pass: Explain plan and lock behavior with rollback fixtures.

topics.title: Async endpoints and SSE
topics.concepts: Offload blocking work, cancellation, backpressure and streaming response semantics.
topics.exercise: Stream a mock model and disconnect mid-response.
topics.assessment: What can fail after HTTP headers are sent?
topics.pass: Disconnect releases upstream resources and load tests show bounded concurrency.

topics.title: Lifespan, middleware and testing
topics.concepts: ASGI request wrapping, correlation IDs, shared clients, test overrides and graceful shutdown.
topics.exercise: Add lifespan and HTTPX integration tests.
topics.assessment: How does worker count change open connections?
topics.pass: Trace IDs survive streaming and each client closes on shutdown.

topics.title: Background tasks and deployment
topics.concepts: In-process tasks versus durable workers, readiness and proxy deadlines.
topics.exercise: Move critical work to a worker, deploy the API and restart during a job.
topics.assessment: Which work may disappear on restart?
topics.pass: Deployment drains properly and critical jobs resume.

stages.title: Neural networks and transformers
stages.prerequisite: Applied linear algebra, gradients and NumPy
stages.objective: Trace tensor shapes from token IDs to generated tokens.
stages.scenario: Long prompts inflate time to first token and GPU memory.
stages.progression: Manual attention → PyTorch block → inference benchmark.
stages.gate: Implement masked attention and explain observed prefill/decode behavior.

topics.title: Neural layers and autograd
topics.concepts: Hand gradient, PyTorch modules, affine layers, nonlinearities, backprop and train/eval.
topics.exercise: Train a small classifier and verify a gradient.
topics.assessment: Why do stacked linear layers collapse?
topics.pass: Diagnose one failed training run.

topics.title: Tokenization and representations
topics.concepts: Bytes, subwords, special IDs, padding, truncation, embeddings, pooling and positions.
topics.exercise: Compare English and Bangla token counts and inspect position handling.
topics.assessment: Why is character count a poor token proxy?
topics.pass: Explain retrieval vectors vs token embeddings and choose a safe cutoff.

topics.title: QKV and scaled attention
topics.concepts: Compute by hand and NumPy: QK transpose, scaling, masking, softmax and V.
topics.exercise: Implement a tiny attention example.
topics.assessment: Why scale logits by square root of the key dimension?
topics.pass: Compare shapes and values with PyTorch.

topics.title: Transformer blocks and architectures
topics.concepts: Heads, feed-forward, residuals, normalization, encoder/decoder, cross-attention and pretraining.
topics.exercise: Implement masked block fragment and inspect model cards.
topics.assessment: Which models can attend bidirectionally?
topics.pass: Future-token changes cannot affect earlier masked output.

topics.title: Generation, KV cache and GPU
topics.concepts: Logits, greedy/temperature/top-p, prefill/decode, context scaling, device transfer and cache memory.
topics.exercise: Implement sampling and profile local inference.
topics.assessment: Why does cache memory rise with context?
topics.pass: Estimate KV bytes and explain TTFT, decode and memory changes.

stages.title: LLM application engineering
stages.objective: Place model behavior behind an explicit, measurable contract.
stages.scenario: An AI ticket draft is schema-valid but assigns an incorrect urgency.
stages.progression: Extractor → ticket assistant → provider release gate.
stages.gate: Separate timeout, truncation, refusal and schema failure; compare with a simple baseline.

topics.title: Provider adapter and prompt versions
topics.concepts: Roles, templates, examples, context budget, output usage and upstream errors.
topics.exercise: Build a thin adapter and compare two prompt versions.
topics.assessment: Which provider differences leak through an abstraction?
topics.pass: Trace the prompt and model configuration for each result.

topics.title: Structured output and model selection
topics.concepts: Schema constraints, semantic validation, bounded repair, refusals and cost-quality routing.
topics.exercise: Compare rules, classifier and model on the ticket set.
topics.assessment: Why is schema validity insufficient?
topics.pass: Distinguish refusal, truncation, timeout and valid-but-wrong answers.

stages.title: Embeddings and semantic search
stages.objective: Build an exact search baseline and measure when approximation helps.
stages.scenario: Exact part numbers and Bangla paraphrases both matter.
stages.progression: NumPy cosine → PostgreSQL search → filtered ANN benchmark.
stages.gate: Publish Recall@k, nDCG and latency on the same labeled workload.

topics.title: Embeddings and multilingual fit
topics.concepts: Bi-encoders, pooling, normalization, model dimensions, prefixes and versioning.
topics.exercise: Compare two models on one judged corpus.
topics.assessment: Why rebuild an index when embeddings change?
topics.pass: Publish language and identifier slices under matched settings.

topics.title: Exact similarity and rank metrics
topics.concepts: Dot, cosine, L2, top-k, ties, Recall@k, MRR and nDCG.
topics.exercise: Match SQL rankings to NumPy and hand-check metrics.
topics.assessment: How can MRR rise while recall falls?
topics.pass: Metrics match tiny fixture math and model results use held-out labels.

topics.title: Lexical retrieval and filters
topics.concepts: Inverted indexes, analyzers, BM25 intuition, metadata and authorization filtering.
topics.exercise: Build PostgreSQL lexical search for IDs, phrases and private versions.
topics.assessment: How does tokenization affect a SKU?
topics.pass: Search fixtures cover exact identifiers and unauthorized documents.

topics.title: pgvector ANN
topics.concepts: HNSW graph intuition, IVFFlat clustering, operator classes, build and search settings.
topics.exercise: Benchmark exact vs ANN under representative filters.
topics.assessment: When can index-time filtering reduce candidate recall?
topics.pass: Report recall, p95, build time and index bytes.

stages.title: Grounded RAG
stages.prerequisite: Document processing, structured outputs and search
stages.objective: Build a versioned cited answer service with abstention.
stages.scenario: A current policy supersedes an older copy.
stages.progression: Fixed chunks → basic Q&A → versioned citations.
stages.gate: Localize errors to parsing, retrieval, context or generation.

topics.title: Fixed windows and overlap
topics.concepts: Token lengths, stride, stable IDs, offsets and duplicate evidence.
topics.exercise: Sweep lengths and overlap settings.
topics.assessment: When does overlap waste context?
topics.pass: Report boundary recall and duplicate tokens.

topics.title: Sentence and recursive splitting
topics.concepts: Sentence grouping, separators, fallbacks and long input.
topics.exercise: Compare sentence and recursive cuts.
topics.assessment: How can sentence splitting fail on abbreviations?
topics.pass: Token limits and offsets hold on long and multilingual fixtures.

topics.title: Structure-aware chunks
topics.concepts: Headings, tables, page coordinates and provenance.
topics.exercise: Preserve rows and heading context.
topics.assessment: When should a section be divided further?
topics.pass: Table answers link to correct rows and pages.

topics.title: Context, citations and abstention
topics.concepts: Deduplication, budget, conflict and claim-to-source spans.
topics.exercise: Build restricted context and validate citation handles.
topics.assessment: Can the correct document still lack the claimed evidence?
topics.pass: Reject unknown citations and score unsupported claims.
topics.defer: Using a judge as an oracle

topics.title: Index consistency and lifecycle
topics.concepts: Generation swaps, embedding versions, replay and tombstones.
topics.exercise: Activate a new index and roll back after a source deletion.
topics.assessment: How does rollback avoid resurrecting removed sources?
topics.pass: Readers see complete generations and deleted artifacts stay inactive.

topics.title: Enterprise citation verification
topics.concepts: Authenticated navigation, document version, span provenance and no-answer handling.
topics.exercise: Verify citations direct readers to active, authorized evidence.
topics.assessment: Why isn't a valid ID sufficient?
topics.pass: Revocation makes stale cited sources inaccessible.

stages.title: Advanced retrieval
stages.objective: Tune only quality failures seen in a controlled experiment.
stages.scenario: Ambiguous questions need evidence spread across multiple documents.
stages.progression: Fusion → reranking → measured routing and context policy.
stages.gate: Report paired quality, latency and cost alongside a rollback plan.

topics.title: Semantic, parent-child and contextual chunks
topics.concepts: Similarity boundaries, small-to-large retrieval and contextual enrichment.
topics.exercise: Run matched ablations with source and ACL preservation.
topics.assessment: Can a parent cross a permission boundary?
topics.pass: Report quality, token cost, duplication and provenance.

topics.title: Hybrid and reranking
topics.concepts: Sparse/dense union, rank fusion, cross-encoder batching and cutoff.
topics.exercise: Compare sparse, dense, hybrid and reranked retrieval.
topics.assessment: What can reranking never recover?
topics.pass: Report held-out recall, quality delta and p95.

topics.title: Rewrites, compression and multi-hop
topics.concepts: Query expansion, drift, context extraction, routing and bounded decomposition.
topics.exercise: Compare original query against one bounded second step.
topics.assessment: When should rewriting be bypassed?
topics.pass: Preserve IDs and report evidence retention and cost.

stages.title: Evaluation and LLMOps
stages.prerequisite: An AI feature with a baseline
stages.objective: Use reproducible evaluations to decide what ships.
stages.scenario: A cheaper model improves average scores but regresses on an important slice.
stages.progression: Hand-labeled benchmark → CI gate → staged rollout.
stages.gate: Seed a regression and show that evaluation blocks release.

topics.title: Gold sets and retrieval/answer separation
topics.concepts: Grouped splits, hard negatives, recall, correctness, support and abstention.
topics.exercise: Create a human rubric and labeled dataset.
topics.assessment: When should an answer have been impossible?
topics.pass: Localize failed outputs to retrieval, context or answer stages.

topics.title: Calibrating model judges
topics.concepts: Rubrics, position/verbosity bias and disagreement.
topics.exercise: Compare judge runs with a reviewed subset.
topics.assessment: Which slice needs human review?
topics.pass: Publish agreement and examples of mismatch.

topics.title: Version lineage and staged rollout
topics.concepts: Version model, prompt, parser, index, dataset and code; paired comparisons and rollback.
topics.exercise: Create an evaluation manifest and block a seeded regression.
topics.assessment: When does a good average hide a dangerous slice?
topics.pass: Reviewer reproduces artifact selection and observes rollback.

topics.title: Drift, feedback and monitoring
topics.concepts: Input shifts, outcome proxies, feedback bias and alert owners.
topics.exercise: Simulate a quality regression and write a triage runbook.
topics.assessment: Why can approval rate mislead?
topics.pass: Show one alert, root cause investigation and follow-up.

stages.title: Defensive AI security
stages.prerequisite: Authentication and a working AI pipeline
stages.objective: Enforce identity, authority, privacy and safe review boundaries in code.
stages.scenario: Different tenants use shared indexes, workers and caches.
stages.progression: Permission tests → threat model → defensive release review.
stages.gate: Verify real application permissions, revocation and deletion across derived data.

topics.title: Tenant isolation and privacy
topics.concepts: Actor claims, ACL, row-level policies, object keys, cache namespaces, retention and vendor handling.
topics.exercise: Test cross-tenant access with the real application role.
topics.assessment: What can a privileged service account bypass?
topics.pass: Denials cover search, fetch, cache and job results; deletion is traced.
topics.defer: Dedicated database per tenant by default

topics.title: Prompt injection defenses and responsible AI
topics.concepts: Untrusted inputs, server policy, objective harm, human review and redacted logging.
topics.exercise: Verify with inert fixtures that document content cannot grant rights.
topics.assessment: Which boundary remains effective even if model output is wrong?
topics.pass: Model or document instructions cannot change tool/data authority.

topics.title: Safe query compilation
topics.concepts: Typed intents, templates, read-only views, bound parameters and tenant scopes.
topics.exercise: Compile allowed analytics requests into approved queries.
topics.assessment: Why does validating SQL syntax fail to establish authorization?
topics.pass: Forbidden operations never reach the reporting connection.

topics.title: Limits, clarification and audit
topics.concepts: Ambiguity, row caps, statement timeout, audit and result accuracy.
topics.exercise: Test reporting rejection and timing boundaries.
topics.assessment: When should the assistant ask a follow-up?
topics.pass: Report execution accuracy and predictable denial behavior.

stages.title: Business workflows and MCP
stages.prerequisite: Validated model outputs, evaluation and defensive authorization
stages.objective: Build useful bounded workflows that recover consistently.
stages.scenario: An ERP request times out after it might have committed.
stages.progression: Read tools → durable approval state machine → replay and reconciliation.
stages.gate: Restart around an approved write and verify one effective external operation.

topics.title: Deterministic and model-led planning
topics.concepts: Explicit states, dynamic information gathering, step budgets and stopping.
topics.exercise: Compare fixed research flow with bounded decomposition.
topics.assessment: When does model-led planning justify its cost?
topics.pass: Measure success, evidence support and steps under the same fixtures.

topics.title: Agent evaluation and team patterns
topics.concepts: Trajectory constraints, replay, role separation and handoff cost.
topics.exercise: Compare a two-role design to typed stages.
topics.assessment: Can different trajectories be valid?
topics.pass: Unauthorized effects fail evaluation even when answers look correct.

topics.title: Tool calling and MCP primitives
topics.concepts: Schema, typed execution, host/client/server, tools/resources/prompts and negotiation.
topics.exercise: Implement a read-only MCP inventory service and client.
topics.assessment: Who executes a model's tool request?
topics.pass: Discovery succeeds and malformed calls cause no effects.

topics.title: MCP authorization and compatibility
topics.concepts: Protocol pinning, transport trust, scopes, capability drift and availability.
topics.exercise: Scope read tools and simulate unavailable or incompatible service.
topics.assessment: Where does execution authority belong?
topics.pass: Wrong scope, timeout and schema change fail safely.

topics.title: State, checkpoints and approval
topics.concepts: Workflow vs chat memory, TTL, immutable intent, approval binding and final checks.
topics.exercise: Persist and resume an ERP approval flow.
topics.assessment: What if the approver changes roles before execution?
topics.pass: Mutated, stale and revoked approvals fail safely.

topics.title: Failure recovery and reconciliation
topics.concepts: Unknown outcomes, idempotency, status probes, compensation and dead letters.
topics.exercise: Simulate timeout after a mock ERP commit.
topics.assessment: When must a human resolve ambiguity?
topics.pass: Restart reconciles to one effective external operation.

stages.title: Production and distributed systems
stages.objective: Deploy and operate a cost-bounded, observable AI service.
stages.scenario: Provider latency grows, the queue backs up and Redis is unavailable.
stages.progression: Compose → one-cloud staging → load and failure drill.
stages.gate: An independent reviewer can deploy, trace a failure, restore and roll back.

topics.title: Redis cache and rate limits
topics.concepts: Strings, hashes, sorted sets, TTL, cache-aside, invalidation, stampedes and atomic quotas.
topics.exercise: Build scoped cache and load-test tenant limits.
topics.assessment: When is fail-open unacceptable?
topics.pass: Test stale entries, concurrent limits and cache outage.

topics.title: RabbitMQ, outbox and workers
topics.concepts: Exchanges, confirms, acks, prefetch, backpressure, retry budgets, DLQ and outbox.
topics.exercise: Kill workers before and after commit.
topics.assessment: How do consumer acks differ from publisher confirms?
topics.pass: Deduplicate replay and recover incomplete jobs.

topics.title: Docker, CI and cloud staging
topics.concepts: Layers, non-root images, signals, CI artifacts, IAM, network boundaries and health checks.
topics.exercise: Deploy API and workers from CI artifacts on one cloud.
topics.assessment: Why does graceful drain matter?
topics.pass: Staging reproduces builds and handles backward-compatible migration.

topics.title: OpenTelemetry traces and metrics
topics.concepts: Context propagation, redacted structured logs, histograms and cardinality.
topics.exercise: Trace an API request across a queue and model call.
topics.assessment: Which metadata should never become a label?
topics.pass: Locate a bottleneck without private prompts in telemetry.

topics.title: Capacity, latency and cost
topics.concepts: Traffic envelope, TTFT, p95, quotas, saturation, per-task cost and resource isolation.
topics.exercise: Model 10x load and run a noisy-neighbor test.
topics.assessment: When should a tenant get dedicated capacity?
topics.pass: State workload, bottlenecks, error rates and per-tenant behavior.

topics.title: Timeouts, retries and circuit breakers
topics.concepts: End-to-end deadlines, jitter, error categories, bulkheads, shedding and breaker state.
topics.exercise: Inject provider slowness and Redis failure.
topics.assessment: How do retries amplify an incident?
topics.pass: Bound retries and backlog while keeping authoritative data consistent.

topics.title: SLO, restore and rollback
topics.concepts: SLIs, error budgets, RTO/RPO, canaries, database restore and incident ownership.
topics.exercise: Rehearse bad release, restore and measured recovery.
topics.assessment: Can healthy uptime hide an AI quality outage?
topics.pass: Publish restore timing and check post-restore deletion rules.

stages.title: Model adaptation and serving
stages.objective: Decide when model adaptation or self-hosting improves outcomes.
stages.scenario: A domain workflow needs output consistency on limited hardware.
stages.progression: Local inference → adapter comparison → optional GPU serving.
stages.gate: Compare quality, license, privacy, VRAM, cost and latency on one holdout.

topics.title: Open weights, quantization and serving
topics.concepts: License, templates, weight/KV precision, GPU memory, continuous batching and vLLM.
topics.exercise: Compare local settings or a managed and local model.
topics.assessment: Why can batching hurt first-token latency?
topics.pass: Report quality, TTFT, throughput and peak VRAM.

topics.title: Fine-tuning, LoRA and QLoRA
topics.concepts: SFT datasets, leakage, masked labels, low-rank updates and quantized bases.
topics.exercise: Prepare licensed examples and train one adapter if compute permits; compare memory separately.
topics.assessment: When is current knowledge better served by RAG?
topics.pass: Compare held-out quality and count trainable parameters.

stages.title: Multimodal document AI
stages.prerequisite: OCR, grounded RAG and held-out evaluation
stages.objective: Combine text, layout and vision with inspectable evidence.
stages.scenario: Scanned invoices contain difficult tables and uncertain totals.
stages.progression: OCR baseline → vision extraction → multimodal retrieval.
stages.gate: Measure field and page accuracy, show abstention and retain provenance.

topics.title: OCR, vision and multimodal retrieval
topics.concepts: Image patch intuition, resolution, text/image embeddings, evidence regions and costs.
topics.exercise: Compare OCR and vision; add page/region retrieval for hard cases.
topics.assessment: When is text extraction enough?
topics.pass: Measure field accuracy and page recall and preserve coordinates.

topics.title: Media lifecycle and validation
topics.concepts: MIME, pixel limits, review status, retention and deterministic verification.
topics.exercise: Validate invoices and handle bounded media uploads.
topics.assessment: Which amounts can be verified deterministically?
topics.pass: Reject invalid media and route uncertain totals to review.

stages.title: System design and senior ownership
stages.objective: Set measurable standards, own trade-offs and grow other engineers.
stages.scenario: A large tenant needs isolation while the service has a tight cost budget.
stages.progression: Architecture review → capstone drill → real cross-team leadership.
stages.gate: Defend a measured decision and gather independent operational review.

topics.title: System design and migrations
topics.concepts: Modular boundaries, staged migrations, dual reads, dependency isolation and cost models.
topics.exercise: Design and review an embedding cutover with a rollback exercise.
topics.assessment: What evidence would justify splitting API and worker further?
topics.pass: Demonstrate cutover consistency and document scaling limits.

topics.title: Architecture review and standards
topics.concepts: ADRs, quality gates, budgets, owner assignment and operational feedback.
topics.exercise: Lead review, write two ADRs and run a game day.
topics.assessment: What new evidence would make you retire a standard?
topics.pass: Independent review, peer adoption and follow-up decision evidence.

topics.title: Mentoring and communication
topics.concepts: Teach debugging, review trade-offs and communicate scope to stakeholders.
topics.exercise: Mentor a peer through a delivery problem and request feedback.
topics.assessment: How did you verify the person could repeat the reasoning?
topics.pass: Peer independently applies the method and gives attributable feedback.

stages.title: Remote AI career preparation
stages.objective: Turn practical AI ability and enterprise experience into role-specific proof.
stages.scenario: An asynchronous international hiring loop evaluates written and spoken judgment.
stages.progression: Role mapping → technical mocks → applications and feedback.
stages.gate: Complete two mocks and tie each public claim to verifiable evidence.

topics.title: Python and SQL interviews
topics.concepts: Complexity, streaming, joins, windows, query plans and cancellation.
topics.exercise: Run timed unfamiliar coding and SQL prompts.
topics.assessment: Why did this index help?
topics.pass: Explain edge cases, complexity and measured plan changes.

topics.title: AI design and English communication
topics.concepts: Evaluation, safety, SLOs, trade-offs, evidence and concise asynchronous updates.
topics.exercise: Record 90-second introduction, design review and incident story.
topics.assessment: Which experiment would change your recommendation?
topics.pass: Two independent mocks and a focused retest.

topics.title: Remote role analysis and portfolio
topics.concepts: Role evidence, Bangladesh eligibility, UTC overlap, case studies and transparent claims.
topics.exercise: Tailor two applications and record three proof links per role.
topics.assessment: Which claim is strongest and how can a reviewer verify it?
topics.pass: Each target has eligibility source, next action and evidence.

topics.title: Remote application feedback loop
topics.concepts: Pipeline stages, follow-up, written communication and feedback patterns.
topics.exercise: Log opportunities, mock feedback and a revision action.
topics.assessment: What distinguishes a repeated skills gap from poor role fit?
topics.pass: Review pipeline after two weeks and update target roles from evidence.
